decisions.reason: The GA4 plugin tracks Google's only remaining analytics standard, supports the firm's announced focus on measurable, results-driven services, and embodies development effort the firm wants to recoup through continued use.

The relaunch SEO service has its own page, is central to the firm's shop-relaunch and marketing positioning, and runs on existing specialists, so there is little reason to abandon this visible commitment.

The SEO workshops were launched only recently and are presented on their own page, so any weak early demand can be put down to a start-up phase, and they extend the firm's search-marketing expertise at low cost.
